key_insight: The paper shows that an optimal gate-packing strategy can partition the Quantum Fourier Transform into a distributed circuit while reducing the entanglement cost measured by e-bit count.
engineering_relevance: This improves how QFT-based workloads can be mapped onto multi-QPU quantum hardware, making distributed quantum execution more practical and scalable.
method: Derive a QFT partitioning scheme using optimal gate-packing.
Compare the scheme against prior analytical QFT partitioning methods.
Benchmark against general-purpose circuit partitioners and validate on quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports comparative evaluation of the proposed partitioning method against prior approaches and general-purpose algorithms, plus hardware implementation of the partitioned circuit.
watch_item: Results may depend on hardware connectivity, teleportation overhead, and the fidelity required to preserve the target unitary across QPUs.
paper_title: Towards an Optimally Distributed Quantum Fourier Transform Circuit
